name: Tiana Gill Lilistia
original_name: ティアナ・ジル・リリスティア
source: Comes from the family that has managed Lilithtia Academy for many generations. Knowing that she will eventually inherit this position, she strives to be the perfect student and manager. She sees Luna as a rival and wants to beat her on every field.
translation: Comes from the family that has managed Lilithtia Academy for many generations. Knowing that she will eventually inherit this position, she strives to be the perfect student and manager. She sees Luna as a rival and wants to beat her on every field.
